_comment: Optional cloud sign-in and sync (see docs/CLOUD_SYNC.md). url and publishableKey come from the Supabase project (Project Settings > API) and are PUBLIC by design. Never put a secret key or service_role key here: the build refuses it. methods lists the sign-in buttons to show; only list providers that are switched on in Supabase (microsoft and github here; add google once it is set up).
